(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.workspace-diagnostics'),a=document.querySelector('.live-assistant-launcher');const dr=d.getBoundingClientRect(),ar=a.getBoundingClientRect();if(Math.abs(dr.height-ar.height)>0.5)throw Error('Bar heights differ: '+dr.height+' / '+ar.height);if(Math.abs(dr.top-ar.top)>1)throw Error('Top edges misaligned: '+dr.top+' / '+ar.top);return {diagnostics:dr.height,assistant:ar.height,top:dr.top,touch:matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches}})()
